newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to ship modems to Norway, China.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to ship modems to Norway, China.

text.p: Motorola Inc said on Tuesday it signed separate agreements to provide its CyberSURFR cable modems for use in Norway and China.

The company's Multimedia Group said that Janco Kabel, Norway's leading cable television operator, would test the modems as it offered Internet access to cable subscribers. About 1,000 modems will be installed by the end of January, Motorola said.
In addition, a unit of China's Ministry of Electronics Industry will use Motorola's modems and its own technology to offer voice, data and video communications services in China.
Motorola, which provides communications products and manufactures semiconductors, has yet to determine the number of CyberSURFR modems that will be shipped in 1997, a company spokeswoman said.
